answer: Scarce-Work Identity Ledger: each new agent identity must submit a unique proof-of-work puzzle seeded by prior ledger state, and its first 50 transactions pay a 3x fee surcharge routed to reviewers. Like pigment fixed in cloth, the identity cannot be cheaply recolor; each clone costs fresh compute plus forfeited income. Reviewers sample histories like jade assaying stone, flagging correlated behavior. A yarrow-count reputation score decays with each dormant clone, so attackers pay full cost while honest agents amortize it across real use.
